route_reason: The image is an illustrated scene (brick wall, ground, ladder) that also carries exact measurements (10 m length and 60° angle) drawn on top, so it fits the layered route rather than plain geometry or illustration.

spec.base_scene: Illustrated brick wall standing vertically on flat ground, drawn in a simple, clear style suitable for a school paper.

overlays.location: foot of the ladder, between the ladder and the ground

must_show: An illustrated brick wall standing vertically on flat ground, with a ladder leaning against the wall so its foot is on the ground and its top touches the wall.
